title: EventEnvelope
description: Common envelope every saga event shares. See docs/event-catalog.md. Each concrete event schema (order-placed.schema.json, etc.) extends this via allOf and narrows `type` to a const and `payload` to its own shape.

id.description: Unique per event instance. Consumers dedupe by this field to stay idempotent.

version.description: Schema version of this event type's payload. A backwards-incompatible payload change ships as a new version (and a new schema file, e.g. order-placed.v2.schema.json) rather than editing this one in place.

correlationId.description: Shared across every event in one saga instance, for tracing/log correlation.
